text_block_list.text:
One day, at a train station a short 
distance from the academy...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Oh my? Could you perhaps be Bright-chan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
My, Creek-sama♪ What a coincidence~. 
Whatever brings you to a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I meant to head straight back to the 
academy, but I was so lost in thought 
about what to have for dinner that I 
completely missed my stop~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ I feel the exact same way~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was so captivated by the scenery 
that by the time I realized it~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, that is quite the trouble~... Oh, 
I know. Why don't we head home together? 
If there are two of us, I'm sure you won't 
miss your stop♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I think that is a wonderful idea~. Well 
then, I shall be in your care~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...And so, Tama-chan's reaction when I 
patted her head was just so adorable~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of cuteness, Sister Ryan isn't 
one to lose either~. Her reaction when I 
saw her at the clothing store was――

text_block_list.name: Station Attendant
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me... This is the final stop, so if 
you could please exit the vehicle...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh my~ It seems we got carried away 
chatting again...

...Likewise, I ended up missing my stop 
too. It seems the heartwarming aura around 
the two of them has an effect on those 
nearby as well...
